summary: Describes a way to verify SSH host keys using DNS secured by DNSSEC. It defines a DNS resource record that holds a standard SSH key fingerprint, so a client can check the fingerprint it sees against the one published for the server.

eli5.summary: When you visit a server for the first time, you want to know it is the real one. This memo lets the server publish a fingerprint in the internet's phone book so you can compare.

questions: verify ssh host key with dns
